sync.policy: ROS2 Humble Python ATS two-stream arrival order
sync.arrival_assumption: Each published output emitted after its linked command callback; no measured ROS/DDS scheduling. Independent reference/result queues for position and velocity.

position_publication.policy: suppress flag8 rows before position ATS; velocity always published

score.no_silent_exclusions: Primary metrics.all includes every matched published output. Optional flag8 position suppression occurs before its independent ATS and is counted explicitly; velocity retains every row. Nonfinite counted per official accumulator.
